info.title: ReDocumented Slack Web API (params-known subset)
info.description: Generated from methods.json; only methods with params_known: true. Param types are loose strings. This catalog documents Slack's UNDOCUMENTED/internal API surface for a specific workspace (Hack Club, Enterprise Grid). Calling an undocumented method with params_known=false means you would be guessing params against a real backend with unknown side effects -- do not do this against a real account/token without a human in the loop, and never call anything shaped like a write (*.delete, *.set, *.remove, *.create, *.update, and similar) without explicit human confirmation and a clear understanding of the blast radius, even when params_known=true. 'existence-only' verified does NOT mean 'safe to call' -- it only means the method name is real.

query.description: string User prompt or search query.

action_token.description: string Send action_token as received in a message event.

channel_types.description: array Mix and match channel types by providing a comma-separated list of any combination of public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im.

content_types.description: array Content types to include, a comma-separated list of any combination of messages, files, channels, users.

include_bots.description: boolean Whether the results should include bots.

include_deleted_users.description: boolean Whether to include deleted users in the user search results. Defaults to false.

before.description: integer UNIX timestamp filter. If present, filters for results before this date.

after.description: integer UNIX timestamp filter. If present, filters for results after this date.

include_context_messages.description: boolean Whether to include context messages surrounding the main message result. Defaults to false if unspecified.

context_channel_id.description: string Context channel ID to support scoping the search when applicable.

cursor.description: string The cursor returned by the API. Leave this blank for the first request and use this to get the next page of results.

limit.description: integer Number of results to return, up to a max of 20. Defaults to 20.

sort.description: enum The field to sort the results by. Defaults to score. Can be one of: score, timestamp.

sort_dir.description: enum The direction to sort the results by. Defaults to desc.

include_message_blocks.description: boolean Whether to return the message blocks in the response.

highlight.description: boolean Whether to highlight the search query in the results. Defaults to false if unspecified.

term_clauses.description: array A list of term clauses. A term clause is a string with search terms. Search results returned will match every term clause specified (i.e., conjunctive normal form).

modifiers.description: string A string containing only modifiers in the format of modifier:value. Search results returned will match the modifier value. For now modifiers only affect term clauses.

include_archived_channels.description: boolean Whether to include archived channels in the search results.

disable_semantic_search.description: boolean Whether to disable semantic search. When true, only keyword-based search is used. Defaults to false.
